name: How does green building support wildfire resilience?

mainEntity.name: How does green building support wildfire resilience?

acceptedAnswer.text: Using fire-resistant materials, ember-resistant vents, hardened roofs, defensible space, and non-combustible landscaping improves home hardening in high fire hazard zones.
